observation: Viewed front, top and iso once. The front now has a complete round black field, two opposed seven-gear chains shrinking toward the orange-backed core, and a quiet low pedestal. Top and iso show the shallow carrier, separate gears, front bezel and single rear support without visibly floating bodies or missing parts. The neutral background is visible through the central aperture and narrow core gap; these stills do not establish translucency, drive, full-cycle collision freedom or print readiness. Independent signature recognition remains pending.
